source: First record of the raw session observation log kept in the task workspace (app-session-observations.jsonl, line 1); the state text is copied unchanged
format: accessibility text export of the App window while the first answer was still generating; not native agent telemetry
what_it_shows: The reading assistant's visible working panel: step summaries, the file it opened (a parsed .jsonl of PDF blocks), one search step with its exact pattern and match count, and draft notes listing block resourceIds; plus the input-bar and PDF-viewer controls

later_state: The finished first answer is in app-followup-complete-ax.txt (round-1 nodes); the App then collapsed this working panel behind the button '已处理（用时 1m 6s）'.
not_included: The other three log records are later snapshots of the same answers (already covered by the complete exports) and are not copied
